note: weights turn the four token kinds into one unit (input-token equivalents): cache write 1.25x, cache read 0.1x, output 5x of the uncached input price. usdPerMillionInputTokens is the uncached input price per model family in USD: null = unknown, nothing is invented; fill it from the provider's price page and agent-usage.js then prints USD too. alerts.ceilingRatio: record-cost.js alerts when a subtask's units (M, as on its usage line) exceed token_ceiling times this ratio; token_ceiling is written '<x> M units' (e.g. 1.2 M units), a legacy value without 'M units' or 'open' gives no ceiling alert. snapshotMaxBytes: agent-usage.js removes the oldest executor traces from usage-snapshot.json over this size (20 MB, provisional, owner 2026-11-06). alerts.handoverContextTokens: context-now.js (called by task-next.js at each closing) prints HANDOVER when the executor context is over it with subtasks left (120k, provisional, owner 2026-11-11, Q6 of task-502).
